Fixture Tools

Merge PDF combines several PDF files into one document in the order you choose, directly in your browser, so the files are never uploaded to a server. Drop the files on the page, drag them into the right order, choose page ranges if you need only some pages, and download the merged document. This fixture page exists only to test the checks of the skill: it has one heading, a canonical link, a description, structured data and enough text in the server HTML for crawlers that do not run JavaScript, which is what the access checker measures before it reports a pass.
